title: Why Does Moss Live Two Lives? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
Green velvet moss on a wall, thin brown stalks rising from it, and brown dots under a fern leaf. Diya asks if the brown stalk is part of the moss or a different plant. It is both: the moss lives two lives, and they take turns.

You will meet the gametophyte and the sporophyte, zoom from a moss plant into its capsule and one spore, and watch the whole life cycle run as a living loop with fertilisation and meiosis as the two switches. Then the two generations side by side in a moss and a fern, a pause and think check, a worked walk around the life of a fern, the exam trap about meiosis, an original NEET pattern question, a recap card and three questions to answer. This is Episode 27 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and NEET students.
